# Task Manager API
A simple RESTful Task Manager API built using Node.js and Express.js.

## Features

- Get all tasks
- Add a new task
- Update an existing task
- Delete a task
- JSON-based responses
- Proper HTTP status codes

## Technologies Used

- Node.js
- Express.js
- Thunder Client (for API testing)

## Project Structure

```
task-manager-api/
│
├── node_modules/
├── package.json
├── package-lock.json
└── server.js
```

## Installation

1. Clone the repository

```bash
git clone <repository-url>
```

2. Navigate to the project folder

```bash
cd task-manager-api
```

3. Install dependencies

```bash
npm install
```

4. Start the server

```bash
node server.js
```

## API Endpoints

### Get All Tasks

```http
GET /tasks
```

### Create New Task

```http
POST /tasks
```

Request Body:

```json
{
  "title": "Complete Practical 4"
}
```

### Update Task

```http
PUT /tasks/:id
```

Request Body:

```json
{
  "title": "Updated Task",
  "completed": true
}
```

### Delete Task

```http
DELETE /tasks/:id
```

## Sample Response

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "title": "Learn Express",
    "completed": false
  }
]
```

## Testing
The API was tested using Thunder Client in Visual Studio Code.
